store_info.name: The Groove Vault
store_info.description: The Groove Vault is a neighborhood listening room and record shop. We stock jazz, soul, hip-hop, and left-field electronic — pressed loud, priced fairly, and ready for your next Saturday spin. This admin portal is where staff add new arrivals, update prices, and keep the bins honest.

products.name: Kind of Blue
products.description: A modal jazz landmark. Cool, spacious, and still the record we hand first-time listeners.

products.name: What's Going On
products.description: Soul with a conscience. Warm strings, soft drums, and a voice that still asks the hard questions.

products.name: Blue Lines
products.description: Bristol trip-hop at its smokiest. Bass you can feel in the floorboards.

products.name: Illmatic
products.description: East Coast hip-hop, tight as a subway turnstile. Every verse earns its place.

products.name: Rumours
products.description: Heartbreak polished into radio gold. The copy we keep behind the counter for rainy days.

products.name: Dummy
products.description: Haunted samples and a voice like late-night film noir. Play it after close.

products.name: The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill
products.description: Hip-hop, soul, and a whole syllabus of feeling. Required listening, forever.

products.name: Discovery
products.description: Robot-pop joy. Sequins, filters, and the best homework soundtrack in the shop.
